```ruby

  def speak = super.upcase
```

challenges.title: Word frequency report
challenges.prompt: Implement words, top and report so the script prints a stop-word-filtered frequency chart. Ties are broken alphabetically and an empty text must not crash.
challenges.starter:
TEXT = <<~T
  The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog barks; the fox runs!
  A quick reply: the fox is quick, the dog is lazy.
T
STOP = %w[the a is over].freeze

# TODO: words(text)   -> lowercase words (letters and apostrophes only), stop words removed
# TODO: top(text, n)  -> the n most frequent [word, count] pairs, ties broken alphabetically
# TODO: report(text, n) -> lines like "dog   ### 3": word padded to the widest word, one # per count, then the count

puts "words: #{words(TEXT).size}, unique: #{words(TEXT).uniq.size}"
puts report(TEXT, 4)
puts top('', 3).inspect
challenges.expected:
words: 16, unique: 9
dog   ### 3
fox   ### 3
quick ### 3
lazy  ## 2
[]
challenges.solution:
TEXT = <<~T
  The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog barks; the fox runs!
  A quick reply: the fox is quick, the dog is lazy.
T
STOP = %w[the a is over].freeze

def words(text)
  text.downcase.scan(/[a-z']+/).reject { |w| STOP.include?(w) }
end

def top(text, n)
  words(text).tally.sort_by { |w, c| [-c, w] }.first(n)
end

def report(text, n)
  rows = top(text, n)
  width = rows.map { |w, _| w.length }.max
  rows.map { |w, c| format("%-#{width}s %s %d", w, '#' * c, c) }
end

puts "words: #{words(TEXT).size}, unique: #{words(TEXT).uniq.size}"
puts report(TEXT, 4)
puts top('', 3).inspect
challenges.explain: scan with a regex extracts words, tally counts them and sort_by with [-count, word] gives a stable ranking. Verified by running the solution with Ruby 4.

challenges.title: A Retrier with exponential backoff
challenges.prompt: Implement Retrier so transient failures are retried with exponentially growing waits, permanent failures are not retried and the log always records the number of attempts. The sleeper is injected so no real time passes.
challenges.starter:
class TransientError < StandardError; end
class PermanentError < StandardError; end

# TODO: class Retrier with attr_reader :log
#   initialize(max: 4, base: 0.5, sleeper: lambda that logs "sleep <seconds>")
#   run { |attempt| ... } retries only TransientError, waiting base * 2**(attempt-1) between tries,
#   re-raises after max attempts, logs PermanentError ("permanent: msg") without retrying,
#   and always logs "done after <attempts>" in ensure. Logs "attempt N failed: msg" and "ok on attempt N".

r = Retrier.new
v = r.run { |n| n < 3 ? raise(TransientError, "boom#{n}") : "value" }
puts v, r.log
r2 = Retrier.new(max: 2)
begin
  r2.run { |n| raise TransientError, "down" }
rescue TransientError => e
  puts "gave up: #{e.message}"
end
puts r2.log
r3 = Retrier.new
begin
  r3.run { raise PermanentError, "bad input" }
rescue PermanentError
  puts r3.log
end
challenges.expected:
value
attempt 1 failed: boom1
sleep 0.5
attempt 2 failed: boom2
sleep 1.0
ok on attempt 3
done after 3
gave up: down
attempt 1 failed: down
sleep 0.5
attempt 2 failed: down
done after 2
permanent: bad input
done after 1
challenges.solution:
class TransientError < StandardError; end
class PermanentError < StandardError; end

class Retrier
  attr_reader :log

  def initialize(max: 4, base: 0.5, sleeper: ->(s) { @log << "sleep #{s}" })
    @max, @base, @sleeper, @log = max, base, sleeper, []
  end

  def run
    attempt = 0
    begin
      attempt += 1
      result = yield attempt
      @log << "ok on attempt #{attempt}"
      result
    rescue TransientError => e
      @log << "attempt #{attempt} failed: #{e.message}"
      raise if attempt >= @max
      @sleeper.call(@base * 2**(attempt - 1))
      retry
    rescue PermanentError => e
      @log << "permanent: #{e.message}"
      raise
    ensure
      @log << "done after #{attempt}"
    end
  end
end

r = Retrier.new
v = r.run { |n| n < 3 ? raise(TransientError, "boom#{n}") : "value" }
puts v, r.log
r2 = Retrier.new(max: 2)
begin
  r2.run { |n| raise TransientError, "down" }
rescue TransientError => e
  puts "gave up: #{e.message}"
end
puts r2.log
r3 = Retrier.new
begin
  r3.run { raise PermanentError, "bad input" }
rescue PermanentError
  puts r3.log
end
challenges.explain: retry re-runs the begin block, the injected sleeper keeps the test deterministic, and ensure records the final attempt count once. Verified by running the solution with Ruby 4.
